merge_dimension: merge pickle files across subdirectories for a given split and dimension into a combined dictionary
merge_split: merge object coverage pickle files for height length and width dimensions and save results
run_merge_object_coverage: run the script to merge object coverage results for train and val splits
review_merge_dimension: review the merge_dimension function to understand how it parses directory names and loads pickle files
refactor_merge_split: refactor merge_split to support additional dimensions beyond height length and width
